findings: Refusal post-state coverage is strictly weaker than the audited postcondition. On s_reason refusal, _attest (~lines 190-204) checks only adapter core, invocations, journal.attestation, source attestation/source_name; a_audit.py:31 requires d.exact(after['journal'], ledger) — complete journal equality including source_generation, staged_source, selected_source, collection, collected. Counterexample fixture: fresh-incomplete case (decision 'source-attest:incomplete-inventory', q_invoked False) with post_a['journal']['source_generation'] or ['staged_source'] mutated — no o07 flag fires while the retained audit rejects. Minimal fix: on refusal require d.exact(post_a['journal'], aa[k]['journal']) plus source-side EXTRA-field equality.

Uncharged restoration before first charge. t.restore(case['source'/'adapter']) (~lines 254-255) executes before any charge.take; a restore-failed case consumes zero charge (continue ~line 259) despite performing typed restoration — contradicting the declared 'len(prefixes) charges per case' and finite-precharge discipline (cf. check.py counter.take(2) before initialization; wave04 'falsevisitcount' control). Fixture: many cases whose payloads raise in t.restore -> audited_prefixes=0, budget untouched. Minimal fix: charge.take(2) or take(len(prefixes)) immediately before the restore calls.

Prefix-0 attestation unreachable. 'if not i: continue' (~lines 282-283) runs before 'if i == k' (~line 296); a case with actions[0]=='source-attest@*' gives k=0, _attest never runs, attests==0 -> 'not_applicable' although an attestation event exists, contradicting the declared semantics ('no source-attest event' -> not_applicable). Fixture: single-action case ('source-attest@0'), rows[0] decision 'source-attest:no-captured-source'. Minimal fix: evaluate the i==k block before the early continue.

Decision-oracle fidelity: _stages (~lines 118-120, 139) uses d.exact (typed equality) where originals use plain != (s_inclusive.py:65, guard_a.py:65, guard_b.py:72). Typed equality is strictly stronger for scalar equivalences (bool/int/float): capture generation serial False vs live 0 makes the original proceed while o07 predicts 'stale-collection' -> false 'counterexample'. Inconsistent with cap[1] compared via ==. Minimal fix: use == for the oracle, or document intentional strictness.
